---
name: grill-me
description: Interview the user about their idea or plan before building anything, one question at a time, until every important decision is made. Use when the user asks to be grilled, mentions "grill me", or asks you to use the grill-me skill.
---

Before you write any code, interview me relentlessly about every aspect of my idea until we reach a shared understanding. Walk down each branch of the design, resolving the decisions that other decisions depend on first.

Ask the questions one at a time. For each question, give your recommended answer, so I can simply agree or choose differently.

If a question can be answered by looking at the files in this folder, look instead of asking.

When every important decision is made, summarise the decisions in a short list and ask whether you can start building.
